deletion_policy.description:
Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance. Defaults to "DELETE".
When a 'terraform destroy' or 'terraform apply' would delete the instance,
the command will fail if this field is set to "PREVENT" in Terraform state.
When set to "ABANDON", the command will remove the resource from Terraform
management without updating or deleting the resource in the API.
When set to "DELETE", deleting the resource is allowed.
deletion_policy.rationale: Controls whether the resource can be deleted through Terraform. Policies should require PREVENT to reduce the risk of accidental or unauthorized deletion.

description.rationale: Human-readable description only. Does not affect security or resource behavior.

display_name.rationale: Friendly display name only. Does not impact security or permissions.

labels.description:
Optional. User defined labels for the zone.

**Note**: This field is non-authoritative, and will only manage the labels present in your configuration.
Please refer to the field `effective_labels` for all of the labels present on the resource.
labels.rationale: Labels are organizational metadata and do not enforce security controls.

lake.rationale: References the parent Dataplex Lake. It determines resource placement rather than security configuration.

location.rationale: Determines the region/zone where the resource is created. Policy should restrict it to an approved-region whitelist for data residency; the allowed set is parameterised (a hardcoded example whitelist is acceptable).

name.rationale: Resource identifier only. Naming is not a security control.

project.rationale: Specifies the GCP project that owns the resource. It is a resource reference rather than a configurable security control.

type.description: Required. Immutable. The type of the zone. Possible values: TYPE_UNSPECIFIED, RAW, CURATED
type.rationale: Determines whether the zone is RAW or CURATED. This is a functional configuration rather than a security setting and has no inherently secure or insecure value.

discovery_spec.description: Required. Specification of the discovery feature applied to data in this zone.

discovery_spec.enabled.rationale: Controls whether automatic discovery is enabled. Policies can require discovery to ensure assets are inventoried and governed.

discovery_spec.exclude_patterns.description: Optional. The list of patterns to apply for selecting data to exclude during discovery. For Cloud Storage bucket assets, these are interpreted as glob patterns used to match object names. For BigQuery dataset assets, these are interpreted as patterns to match table names.
discovery_spec.exclude_patterns.rationale: Controls which file paths or resource naming patterns are skipped during automated discovery. These patterns define discovery scope but do not enforce permissions, access control, or platform security.

discovery_spec.include_patterns.description: Optional. The list of patterns to apply for selecting data to include during discovery if only a subset of the data should considered. For Cloud Storage bucket assets, these are interpreted as glob patterns used to match object names. For BigQuery dataset assets, these are interpreted as patterns to match table names.
discovery_spec.include_patterns.rationale: Controls which objects are included in discovery. This determines discovery behavior rather than enforcing security.

discovery_spec.schedule.description: Optional. Cron schedule (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cron) for running discovery periodically. Successive discovery runs must be scheduled at least 60 minutes apart. The default value is to run discovery every 60 minutes. To explicitly set a timezone to the cron tab, apply a prefix in the cron tab: "CRON_TZ=${IANA_TIME_ZONE}" or TZ=${IANA_TIME_ZONE}". The ${IANA_TIME_ZONE} may only be a valid string from IANA time zone database. For example, "CRON_TZ=America/New_York 1 * * * *", or "TZ=America/New_York 1 * * * *".
discovery_spec.schedule.rationale: Specifies when discovery runs. Scheduling affects operational frequency rather than resource security.

discovery_spec.csv_options.delimiter.description: Optional. The delimiter being used to separate values. This defaults to ','.
discovery_spec.csv_options.delimiter.rationale: Parsing configuration only. No security impact.

discovery_spec.csv_options.disable_type_.description: Optional. Whether to disable the inference of data type for CSV data. If true, all columns will be registered as strings.
discovery_spec.csv_options.disable_type_.rationale: Controls schema inference during discovery. Does not affect permissions or data protection.

discovery_spec.csv_options.encoding.description: Optional. The character encoding of the data. The default is UTF-8.

discovery_spec.csv_options.header_rows.description: Optional. The number of rows to interpret as header rows that should be skipped when reading data rows.

discovery_spec.json_options.disable_type.description: Optional. Whether to disable the inference of data type for Json data. If true, all columns will be registered as their primitive types (strings, number or boolean).

discovery_spec.json_options.encoding.description: Optional. The character encoding of the data. The default is UTF-8.

resource_spec.description: Required. Immutable. Specification of the resources that are referenced by the assets within this zone.

resource_spec.location_type.description: Required. Immutable. The location type of the resources that are allowed to be attached to the assets within this zone. Possible values: LOCATION_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED, SINGLE_REGION, MULTI_REGION
resource_spec.location_type.rationale: Determines the architectural location type of resources within the zone. This is a functional configuration choice rather than a security control, and there is no inherently secure or insecure value to enforce through policy.
